summary.text: Sarah Drennan is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates who has represented District 20 since December 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Sarah Drennan was born in Huntington, West Virginia, graduated from Cabell Midland High School and earned an associate degree from Marshall University.
Her career experience includes working as a registered nurse.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Drennan described herself as a mom and a NICU nurse for 22 years who volunteers in public schools.
She listed job creation and competitive teacher pay among her key messages.
